title: Line time-trial · Level 2: S-bends and zigzags
brief: An S-bend loop of the simulator's line tiles, one lap of 3976 mm: from the start a straight, a 45 degree zigzag, a straight and a 45 degree zigzag heading east, a U-turn (two quarter circles of radius 150 mm), an S-bend up a row, then a straight, a 45 degree zigzag and a straight heading west, and down the west side (a quarter circle, a straight, a quarter circle) back to the start; a 20 mm black line on white, every zigzag corner rounded at radius 15 mm. The robot starts on the line 60 mm along the first straight, heading east, moved up to 15 mm either way and turned up to 4 degrees (run 1 at the nominal start). The robot is the class robot (Configure robot's default: four downward colour sensors 24 and 48 mm ahead, 16 mm either side); a run on a changed robot is not this level's. The clock starts when the middle of the robot's axle first crosses the start line, 40 mm ahead of the nominal start, and stops when it crosses it again a lap later, which ends the run. The run is finished if the axle's middle never goes more than 150 mm from the line's centre and the line is never under none of the sensors for more than 5 s at a time, read on every 1 ms tick from the start line's crossing; the first tick that breaks either rule ends the run, and so does 60 s. Score per run (G03.md's A-081 scoring: a tuned two-state follower passes levels 1 and 2 under the first scoring): 40 for finishing, + 30 x min(1, par / time), + 30 if the axle's middle was never more than 20 mm off the line; 0 for a run that does not finish. Par 22 s. Pass: a mean of at least 60 over the 5 runs, and at least 4 of 5 runs finish.

score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true) >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.lapValid) >= 0.8 * n
